sheets.title: Identity › Devices — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: The panel head gains the add and reload keys every other Identity list has; this device's status is a mark, not a pill; each row says platform, when it was added and when it was last seen.
sheets.before: 0 head keys, 1 text pill (.chip), no dates
sheets.after: 2 head keys (New device, Reload devices), 1 status mark, platform · added · last seen

sheets.title: Registering a device — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: New device opens the same form the directory lists use: name, platform, the commit square and cancel. Focus lands in Name.
sheets.before: no way to add a device
sheets.after: Name + Platform form, Register device commit

sheets.title: A registered device — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: The registration is listed as not yet opened on that device, with a claim key for when that device opens the vault, edit, and remove.
sheets.after: 2 rows; Work laptop marked registered, never seen

sheets.title: Removal is armed — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: Remove arms first and offers Keep beside it, as People, Agents, Applications and Organizations do; the device you are on has no remove key.
